title: Referral Reward Size and New Customer Profitability
authors: Heike M. Wolters; Christian Schulze; Karen Gedenk
eligible_reason: Referral reward size and new-customer profitability: a field experiment at an online bank (small vs large reward mailings, t-tests and chi-square tests, OLS with controls in an appendix) and a telecom field study with continuous reward amounts estimated by mixed-effects models (lmer, glmer, menbreg). No staggered binary treatment and no DiD or event study.
design_notes: Bank: 'Analysis 1_synth.do' (Tables 3-4: ttest/tab by treatment; Appendix B reg newcustvalue rewardsizelarge + controls), 'Analysis 2_synth.do', 'Analysis 3_synth.do'. Telecom: MainModelNrReferrals.do (menbreg number_referrals reward_week ... || id_ec:) and TelecommunicationServiceProviderCode.R (lmer profit_nc ~ referral_reward_nc ... with random effects). Regression inventory empty.
data_files_note: All data files are synthetic ('adapted from the original data to ensure confidentiality'; synthpop in the R session info).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read from data/frame/mksc.jsonl. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
